receiptRunner.source:
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
folder = root / ".artifacts/architecture-round-4"
name, stage, *command = sys.argv[1:]
if command and command[0] == "--":
    command = command[1:]
assert stage in {"source/static", "local", "CI", "publication/install", "deployed/production"}
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
diff = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--binary"])
inputs = {path: hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "HEAD", "--name-only"], text=True).splitlines() if (root / path).is_file()}
log = folder / (name + ".log")
with log.open("wb") as output:
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
receipt = {
    "stage": stage, "obligation": name,
    "owner": "ConsoleFX maintainer; executed by the primary repository agent",
    "subject": source, "workingDiffSha256": hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest(), "workingInputs": inputs, "command": shlex.join(command),
    "configuration": {key: os.environ[key] for key in ["CONSOLE_FX_CDP_PORT", "CONSOLE_FX_STUDIO_PORT", "CONSOLE_FX_TEST_BROWSER"] if key in os.environ},
    "startedAt": started, "observedAt": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "status": "verified" if result.returncode == 0 else "failed", "exitCode": result.returncode,
    "localLog": str(log.relative_to(root)), "logSha256": hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
(folder / (name + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

diagnosis.confidenceFixture: Fully estimated card fixtures violated bounded bearing/type conditions. A valid partial-measurement fixture verifies estimated confidence without changing production limits.
diagnosis.nativeDownloads: The first full suite passed92/94; both recipe byte checks canceled. Four controls isolate destination from URL lifetime: both revocation choices fail on a Linux destination and pass on a valid Windows destination. Shared-directory and browser-session probes verify downloaded bytes. Page-owned settings were lost when the setup page closed; a browser-owned session persists through the test.
diagnosis.sourceChecks: Formatted one browser fixture and documented the narrow no-empty-pattern exception required by Playwright fixture dependency parsing. Type checking then identified a readonly matcher array, an inferred tuple and an optional browser context ID; the final repair retains assertions and fails explicitly if the owned context ID is absent.

limitations: No new GitHub CI, npm publication/registry consumer, deployment or hosted-runtime observation.
Headless browser checks and deterministic SVG parity do not establish real DevTools, physical-device performance, Safari or participant findings.
Screen-reader review remains nonblocking under ADR-0013. Proposed ADR-0016/0017 remain pending.
Prepared static headers do not emulate Vercel routing, aliases, CDN or deployment protection.
Raw logs, download probes and failed traces stay local; this sanitized receipt contains their hashes and bounded conclusions.
invalidators: Changed contract/source/tests/harness/configuration/lock/toolchain or artifact bytes invalidate affected evidence.
A new contradictory result invalidates the affected pass; browser/OS changes require reconciliation.
Publication, CI and hosted states require their own exact-candidate observations and cannot inherit local success.
